name: Metal Dollar
oneLiner: XMD is Metallicus's basket-backed dollar token on XPR Network, reserved by USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar stablecoins managed by the issuer.
collateral: Reserve basket of dollar stablecoins used by Metal Dollar, including USDC, PYUSD, and Paxos-dollar components such as USDP / XPAX
pegMechanism: Basket-backed stablecoin index on XPR Network, with mint and redeem flows intended to keep XMD near one U.S. dollar against the underlying stablecoin basket

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: XMD runs on an unsupported non-EVM network and is backed by freezable centralized stablecoins; available Pharos sources do not prove a direct holder blacklist path on the XMD token itself.

notices.title: XPR Network contract gap
notices.message: CoinGecko resolves XMD on XPR Network, which is not currently a Pharos-supported chain. Runtime coverage uses CoinGecko price and market cap, while contract-level coverage is intentionally skipped.

mintAuthority.summary: XMD is minted/redeemed 1:1 by users depositing whitelisted reserve stablecoins (USDC/PYUSD/USDP) into Metallicus's smart-contract treasury on XPR Network; Metal DAO (MTL) governs which stablecoins enter the basket and their weights, so the mint is user-funded but the eligible-collateral set is governance-controlled.

controls.label: Metal DAO (MTL) basket governance
controls.evidence: Metal DAO (MTL governance token) votes on which stablecoins are eligible for the XMD reserve basket and their weightings; it does not mint XMD directly but bounds the whitelist of reserve assets against which users mint/redeem 1:1.

controls.label: XMD treasury mint/redeem contract
controls.evidence: The smart-contract-managed treasury mints XMD when users deposit basket stablecoins (USDC/PYUSD/USDP) and burns/redeems on the reverse; supply tracks user deposits 1:1 rather than discretionary issuer minting.

review.evidence: Metallicus/XPR Network docs and coverage describe XMD as a reserve-backed stablecoin index treasury: users mint/redeem 1:1 against a basket of fiat-backed stablecoins, while Metal DAO (MTL) governs basket composition and weights. This is a user-collateralized mint bounded by a governance-controlled collateral whitelist. XMD runs on non-EVM XPR Network, so the on-chain admin/owner of the treasury was not independently read.

sources.label: How do I mint Metal Dollar (XMD)?

unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner/admin of the XMD treasury contract on XPR Network and whether Metallicus retains a unilateral mint or pause authority beyond Metal DAO basket votes.
